title: A $14.41 million flood lawsuit, reconstructed from 46 ordinances

beats.text: A single San Francisco flood lawsuit produced 46 signed settlement ordinances.

visual.sub: Forty-six signed orders resolve three different categories of claim

beats.text: Those orders authorize $14.41 million across three kinds of claims.

visual.label: Forty-six signed orders resolve three different categories of claim

beats.text: The 14 orders cover property loss. Another 31 cover diminished property values.
The final order covers statutory attorney fees, costs and interest.

visual.kicker: Forty-six signed orders resolve three different categories of claim

beats.text: Twelve ordinances approved in November 2021 add to exactly $4,946,480.

visual.kicker: Twelve orders match an independently reported cash payment

beats.text: The legislative analyst independently reported that exact amount paid in December.

visual.label: A reserve release reimbursed the enterprise internally

beats.text: It reimbursed the utility for settlements it had already paid.

visual.kicker: A reserve release reimbursed the enterprise internally

beats.text: The utility also reported payments spanning two different storm periods.

visual.kicker: A reserve release reimbursed the enterprise internally

beats.text: Two 2018 entries in the downloaded index still stopped at the Mayor’s Office.

visual.kicker: Two archival status fields lagged the signed ordinances

beats.text: Their signed ordinances confirm both were authorized.

visual.kicker: Two archival status fields lagged the signed ordinances

beats.text: The remaining payment dates and the breakdown of the closing costs still need records.
